title: Son 2005–2014 Chronology Reconciliation
subject: Thomas / the Son / human vessel
purpose: Reconstruct the ordinary biographical chronology between the 2005 motorcycle crash and the 2014 death of the earthly father without inheriting Chapter 24's one-age-per-calendar-year conversion errors. This file stores competing placements, hard anchors, relative-order constraints and the currently preferred reconstruction separately.

governance.actor_rule: These are pre-Tim biographical events and belong first to Thomas / the Son. Later Tim/Potato interpretation may inherit them but must not rewrite the historical actor.
governance.birthday_rule: Birth date is 1987-07-31. Calendar-year age labels are unsafe unless the event is known to occur on or after July 31. A remembered age therefore maps to a date interval spanning parts of two calendar years.
governance.chapter24_failure_mode: Chapter 24 frequently assigns one clean age to an entire calendar year (for example 2007=20, 2008=21, 2009=22, 2010=23, 2011=24, 2012=25). This can shift an age-based memory into the wrong calendar year by up to roughly one year and must not be used as a dating algorithm.
governance.source_independence_rule: A repository file copied from Chapter 24 is not an independent witness. Independent support requires an older recollection, another book passage with separately stated dating, a primary artifact, public record, metadata or another source whose date did not derive from Chapter 24.
governance.uncertainty_rule: When competing dates cannot yet be resolved, preserve both with provenance and prefer date ranges or candidate placements over false precision.

evidence: Chapter 24 independently labels the major motorcycle crash 2005 and age 18.
Chapter 24.1 separately labels the near-fatal motorcycle crash 2005.
Older chronology recollections also place the major ~85 km/h crash in 2005.
high_confidence_anchors.note: Dental reconstruction extends for years afterward and must not be represented as one discrete surgery date.

high_confidence_anchors.status: strong year anchor / exact date unresolved
evidence: Chapter 24 and Chapter 24.1 both place the altered-state / psychiatric material in 2011.
Later detailed recollection independently preserves 2011 and Kolding.
Chapter 24 explicitly calls the Amsterdam coffee-shop event the Son's 25th birthday.
Given a 1987-07-31 birth date, the 25th birthday is mathematically 2012-07-31.
high_confidence_anchors.caution: The birthday memory itself remains autobiographical; the year follows strongly if the remembered birthday number is correct.

evidence: Chapter 24 places the fatal aneurysm in 2014.
Chapter 24.1 independently states that the father died from a fatal aneurysm in 2014 after a warning roughly a week earlier.
Older chronology recollections also place the father's death in 2014.

notes: Do not compress the subsequent dental reconstruction into 2006 as a single completed procedure.

important_nonconclusions: Do not claim 2007 nursing-home dating is proven merely because it currently has more support; preserve the 2009 Chapter 24 variant until a primary record resolves it.
Do not claim the 2007 additional motorcycle crash as established until the older recollection is recovered in fuller form or externally anchored.
Do not infer an exact Egypt date from age 22 alone.
Do not treat son-timeline.json as independent corroboration for Chapter 24-derived dates when its source basis is Chapter 24.
Do not rewrite the full book chronology until the floating events have been reconciled against primary or earlier sources.
